title: A line created before this change reaches the report in the new form
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Require Tech Story is off (Settings, then the Work Orders tab).
  • Have a work order made before this release and not yet invoiced, work order 1, with a labor line, line 1, that has a title and a description and no tech story.
  • Write down line 1's title and description as work order 1's Lines tab shows them.
  • Have line 1 completed with no tech story, and work order 1 completed and invoiced today as invoice A, for this test.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start on Reports, then Export Reports in the Reports left menu, with the Export Report dialog open.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  2. Set the date range to today.
  3. Click Download.
  4. Open the downloaded file in Google Sheets.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 2:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 3:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads.

Step 4:

  • In line 1's row (work order 1's invoice A) the ItemDescription cell reads line 1's title, a space, a hyphen, a space, then its description, exactly as written down, and nothing after it.
  • The cell has none of our field names: no "What are you doing?:", "Why are you doing it?:", "Title:", "Description:" or "Tech Story:", and no semicolon.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-N2: “No line falls back to the old labels or the old questions, including lines created before this change.”
  • S3-R1: “A line's text joins the title, the description and the technician's narrative with a spaced hyphen and no labels: "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned".”
  • S3-R3: “A separator appears only between two segments that are both present. A line with no description joins the title straight to the narrative. A line with no narrative ends after the description. A line with neither carries the title alone. In every case there is no trailing separator and no trailing space. A segment made only of spaces counts as absent.”
  • Story 3, context note: “Context note: the Batch 1 branch first built this change as "Title: ...;Description: ...". It never reached develop or a release, so the released product and develop both still send "What are you doing?: ...;Why are you doing it?: ...;Tech Story: ...", and this change goes straight from that to S3-R1. There is no intermediate format to migrate from. The complaint being answered is not which field names print, it is that any of our field names print at all. That is also why the narrative lost its "Tech Story:" label on 2026-09-16: the label was the same defect, sitting in the same field.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
